Battery Smart is India’s largest Battery-as-a-Service provider for two and three wheelers, empowering riders with convenient, low-carbon mobility.

## The Challenge

### India is the world’s largest two-wheeler (2W) and three-wheeler (3W) market, selling 17.5 million and 1.2 million vehicles respectively in FY24.1 Carbon emissions from these vehicles constitute as much as 30% of total transport emissions in the country.2 [...] Battery Smart has achieved Pan-India scale by standardising its technology which can be seamlessly adopted across multiple original equipment manufacturers’ vehicles, ensuring its model is truly plug and play. The company’s strong focus on hardware design, coupled with a proprietary software tech stack and deep understanding of data analytics has enabled Battery Smart to remain agile towards technology improvements in India’s rapidly-growing EV market. [...] ## Battery Smart's Solution

### Battery Smart is India’s largest battery-swapping network for electric 2Ws and 3Ws. For every vehicle added to its network, the company helps to avoid three tonnes of carbon.5

Since launching in 2020, Battery Smart has reached ~45,000 2W and 3W riders by expanding a network of ~1,000 battery swapping stations across ~30 cities in India with ~120,000 batteries in circulation. To date, they have completed ~35 million swaps, reducing ownership costs of EVs by as much as 30% compared to traditional charging and increasing daily net earning potential by up to 40% due to increased driving range.6
